name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches 'Never pick up the box'. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost already encodes the 'before the door was opened' condition in its definition, so a plain Absence is right, with 'try not to' making it soft. The soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later' — has_door_key is a lasting condition, so door_open must hold by the last step the key is held, which is exactly that wording, and 'try to' makes it soft. The task has no unconditional hard goal (only the box pickup, which is forbidden), so the empty FINAL_STATES and rule-only warning are valid.
